title: Useless. Needs better design.
text:
Useless. Needs better design.. 5 stars to the company who shipped the product. Quick, efficient, fair price.

5 stars for looks and quality of material. Sturdy, hefty, and will last forever.

HOWEVER,

1 star for design. The design renders it useless for the intended purpose, and therefor my one star rating. The slats are spaced too far apart, and the bottom rim is too shallow. One or both need to be changed in order to not have an issue with keeping the utensils in place. Utensils will slide out. If you have to pack it tight to keep them in place, what happens when you use a few? They start sliding out! Who wants to fight that? Not I!! No one should have to try to work with it in some special way to make it functional. It is meant to toss utensils in and be done with it. No wrestling or careful placement to keep utensils from sliding out. All of this would go away if the bottom tray went higher up the sides, and or the side slats were spaced tighter together.

I'm looking for a way to augment this item so I can use it as intended, or to find another use for it altogether. Right now, it is a waster of $15. I'll let you know if I come up with something. Let me know if you think of something!

I have their fruit basket and paper towel holder, which I have been pleased with.
